Hi Shuaiqi, 

Thanks for sending the code. I haven't been able to replicate the problem you mentioned, so I'm not sure what happened when you were getting those errors. The model as you have it now seems to work ok, but not great. In particular the Rhats and effective sample sizes for lp__ and sigma_epsilon are a bit concerning. 

Instead of epsilon ~ normal(0, sigma_epsilon), I would suggest defining the epsilon vector in transformed parameters as the product sigma_epsilon * epsilon_raw, where epsilon_raw is declared in the parameters block, is the same size as epsilon, and is given standard normal priors (i.e. epsilon_raw ~ normal(0,1)). Statistically this is the same thing as what you currently have but it should help with sampling and I think you'll see the problematic Rhats decrease and effective sample sizes increase.

Jonah
